locations.name: Bellwether Yards
locations.prose: A repair yard that outgrew its own harbour and never admitted it. Three gantries, a customs shed with a leaking roof, and a market that keeps its own hours.

locations.name: Kestrel Reach
locations.prose: A yard town that has outlived three owners and kept all their paperwork. The gate crews here know the hour you arrived and will mention it.

locations.name: Thennet Shoals
locations.prose: A day out and already a different trade: tenders, tank farms, and a strip of chandlers who buy anything that will fit through a hatch.

locations.name: Caravel Station
locations.prose: A ring of warehouses around a gate that never closes, where everything stops on its way somewhere better. Nobody is from here.

locations.name: Grieve's Hollow
locations.prose: A cut in a dead moon with one gate and no second way out. What comes up out of the Hollow leaves the way it arrived, or not at all.

locations.name: Lamentation
locations.prose: Far enough out that the chart draws it apart from everything, and spoken of at Caravel the way people speak of weather in a country they have never visited.
